name: bd3
style: Flat 2D illustration from a children's picture book about the human body. {subject} The whole figure visible, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright warm colours, clean simple shapes. No green anywhere on the subject. No text, no letters, no ground, no shadow, no scenery.

items.heart: A single cute cartoon human heart organ (simplified anatomical shape, not a love heart symbol) in red and dark red with a few short blue and red blood vessels on top, a happy smiling face
items.lungs: A single pair of cute cartoon human lungs, two soft pink lobes joined by a light windpipe on top, simple and friendly with a happy smiling face
items.brain: A single cute cartoon human brain in soft pink with wavy folds, seen from the side, with a happy smiling face
items.stomach: A single cute cartoon human stomach organ, a soft orange-pink bean shaped bag, with a happy smiling face
items.intestines: A single cute cartoon of human intestines, a long soft pink tube coiled in neat loops inside a frame of a thicker light orange tube, with a happy smiling face
items.skeleton: A single cute friendly cartoon child skeleton standing and waving, white bones with light grey shading, big round friendly skull with a smile, not scary
items.muscle: A single cartoon child's arm flexing a big strong muscle, the arm bent at the elbow with a tight fist, peach skin, a short yellow t-shirt sleeve at the shoulder, seen from the side
